comparison.objective: Identify and open the correct junction box, free a cable, reclose it, and extract the cable, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective lid manipulation and cable extraction versus precision tool insertion, fine rotation, locking torque, and dynamic feedback tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Only the containing box opened, then closed, with the entire cable released into the tray versus two safe stopping cycles and a passed lock-retention test.
comparison.reason: Opening/reclosing and extraction are different from calibration and impact control. No spec versions are present; the short body omits numeric lid, cable, and tray thresholds.
